portfolioItem.title: Improving Order-to-Delivery Cycles in Footwear Industry with Microsoft ERP
portfolioItem.services: AI Implementation, Inventory Management, Supply Chain Optimization
portfolioItem.excerpt: AI-powered inventory optimization system that reduced stockouts and holding costs for a major retail chain.

description.content: A nationwide retail chain with over 75 stores was struggling with inventory management challenges including stockouts of popular items and excess inventory of slow-moving products. These issues were impacting customer satisfaction and significantly affecting profitability.

The client needed an intelligent inventory management system that could accurately forecast demand across different regions, optimize stock levels, and streamline the replenishment process while adapting to seasonal trends and market fluctuations.

We developed and implemented an AI-powered inventory optimization solution using machine learning algorithms to analyze historical sales data, seasonal patterns, promotional events, and external factors like weather and local events. The system provided automated replenishment recommendations and dynamic safety stock calculations. Within six months of implementation, the client experienced a 35% reduction in stockouts, 28% decrease in inventory holding costs, and 15% improvement in inventory turnover.

features: Advanced demand forecasting using machine learning
Real-time inventory visibility across all locations

relatedItems.title: A Manufacturer of Outdoor and Marine Equipment Streamlines Operations with Dynamics 365 Business Central
relatedItems.excerpt: Successfully implemented a comprehensive Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP system for Engineers & Services in 3 months.

description.content: Engineers & Services, a leading international manufacturer of outdoor and marine equipment, partnered with Vatsin Technology to bring consistency and visibility across their operations through a cloud-based ERP implementation.

The client sought a rapid yet robust ERP solution to unify processes across production, supply chain, and finance. Their existing systems lacked integration and visibility, hindering operational efficiency and scalability.

Vatsin implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central within 90 days, achieving end-to-end integration across key functions. The platform offered centralized data visibility, streamlined processes, and real-time operational tracking. Post-deployment, Windlass reported a substantial improvement in process standardization and decision-making speed.

features: End-to-end cloud ERP implementation within 90 days
Unified production, inventory, and financial workflows
Rapid go-live with minimal disruption to operations
